description: A fluent model preparation library similar to FluentValidation, designed for cleaning and preparing model data with configurable rules.
releaseNotes:
Version 3.0.4: Minor update and improvements.
      Version 3.0.3: Minor update and improvements.
      Version 3.0.2: Fixed support for nested object properties in property selectors.
      - Fixed ArgumentException when accessing nested properties (e.g., x => x.NestedObject.Property)
      - Added proper handling of MemberExpression chains for nested property access
      - Improved expression tree processing with ParameterReplacer for nested properties
      Version 3.0.1: Fixed TrimAllProperties() method exception when processing entire model.
      - Fixed ArgumentException in PropertyPreparationRule when using model => model expression
      - Added ModelPreparationRule class for operations on entire model
      Version 3.0.0: Migrated to .NET Standard 2.0 for maximum compatibility.
      Updated Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Abstractions to 3.1.20.
      Version 1.1.0: Major feature update with advanced preparation capabilities.
      - TrimAllProperties() method for recursive string trimming across nested objects
      - Include() method for reusing preparation configurations (similar to FluentValidation)
      - Collection support with EmptyIfNull(), NullIfEmpty(), RemoveNulls(), RemoveDuplicates(), LimitTo()
      - List-specific operations including Sort() with custom comparisons
      - DateTime preparation with ToUtc(), ToLocalTime(), ToDateOnly(), DefaultIfMinValue()
      - Numeric preparation with Clamp() and DefaultIfZero() methods
      - Enhanced string operations: Truncate(), PadToLength(), Replace(), RemoveCharacters(), DefaultIfEmpty()
      - Improved reflection utilities for deep object processing
      - Better type-specific preparers for DateTime, numeric types, and collections
title: MKS Model Preparation Library
